contexts.text: The flame of a sword turning itself () = man's Own love with its insane cupidities and derivative persuasions... (Compare AC 312.)
Flame... is the essential of heat and light, for they come from it.
They can represent a shining white flame round the head... which is an angelic sign. SE 3701:2.
Faces of flames () = cupidities.
An intense flaming appearance fell down before my eyes...
The lucidity was beautifully varied with rays of golden flame for those who are in affections of good...
In the love of self and its cupidities there is a certain flaming, and delight thence.
There are atmospheres flaming as with gold.
Under Colour, see this reference.
They spoke with me by... flames of various colours.

Man was so created that there was no other distinction between the will and the understanding than such as there is between flame and the light from it. Love and charity would be as the flame, and all perception and thought as the light from it.

Love and charity are a celestial flame, and faith is the spiritual light from it... There, the Celestial of the Lord manifests itself... by a flaming beam as of the sun, and the Spiritual of the Lord, by the light from it...
With celestial flame and spiritual light, the case is this...
Loves and their affections are (there) represented by flames, and this with an inexpressible variation... whence it is that by flames, in the Word, are signified the goods which are of love...
(In the interior Heaven) celestial things... are expressed by variations of flame or of celestial heat; thus they move all the affections. AC 3346:end.
By the Celestial is meant all the flame of good from the Lord.
Love is circumstanced as is flame...
All celestial and spiritual heat, or love and charity, is perceived in the external form... as what is flaming from the Sun.
The universals of love and faith... thus the universals of flame and light...
The Lord flows into the delights of charity with the light of truth and the flame of good...
In the Heavens such things are presented to view by variations of celestial light and of celestial flame...
The good of charity is like a flame which affords light... AC 5637. AC 5816:2. AC 6135:3. AC 6272. AC 6400.
The flaming lucidity represented the Intellectual (of the Celestial Church)... For flaming lucidity signifies truth from good. DMin 4712.
The light in Heaven... differs accordingly as it is tempered with the flaming and the shining white.
The things of the affections of good they saw represented by suitable small flames. SE 4028.
The influx of Divine love is represented to the Angels by a celestial flame which affects them with Divine good.
Truth does not shine from itself, because in it alone there is nothing flaming; but it shines from good, for good is like a flame from which comes light.
It is this heat which is meant in the Word by flame etc. AC 6032:end.

The distance is greater or less according to the sparkling and the flaming in the object; for if it is flaming, it appears at a much greater distance... And as, in the world, what is flaming spreads itself to the greatest extent, so, in the Spiritual World, does good and its affection; for flame corresponds to the affection of good.
When the thought of the (higher) Angels falls down, it appears like a flaming light... The flaming flows into the affection of love (of the Spirits below), but does not appear to them... HH 210.
The flaming represented the Lord...
The flame of that Sun is nothing but Divine love.
In a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush () = Divine love in scientific truth. A flame of fire = Divine love.

The reason flame = Divine love, is that in its first origin love is nothing but fire and flame from the Lord as a Sun... Hence it is that when the Lord appeared in vision, He appeared as fire and flame. Illustrated.
The Divine good of the Lord's Divine love was here () seen as a flame of fire.
Thus the flame of fire () is the Divine truth which is in the Word, which is from the Lord's Divine good.
Eyes as a flame of fire () = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord's Divine good.
That a flame of fire = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, is evident from .
That fire and flame, in the opposite sense, = filthy loves... Illustrated.
There appeared a flame of considerable brightness blazing cheerfully... This flame signified the advent of Spirits of Mercury more prompt than the rest.
(Description of a very beautiful flame, which was afterwards changed into a bird.) AC 622. Explained. SE 3246.
What is flaming celestial love and its affections.
Good is as flame, and truth is as light.
No Angel can endure the flame from the Divine love...
The Divine good in itself is an infinite flame of ardour, that is, of love...
The Divine good is a flame... The flame itself does not appear in Heaven, but only light in which is the flame, which is thus perceived as heat, which is love.
The flame which burneth after him () = the desire of falsity.
Flames = Divine truths proceeding from the Lord's Divine good.
Under Anger, see this reference.
Fire, and flame () = the love of self.
All colours there are modifications of heavenly light and flame... which are variegations of truth and good, thus of intelligence and wisdom.
In the inmost Heaven Divine truth appears as flaming light...
The luminary = mutual love from its flame, which = this love; and it = charity from the heat and light therefrom. AC 9570:end.
The light of the Celestial Heaven appears as flame, because in that Heaven there reigns the good of love, which is presented to view in Heaven by a flame. AC 9865.

(Good and truth) are like flame and light; flame does not appear without light... and light does not come into existence without flame... Moreover, the flame or fire of life is love; and the light of life is faith. AR 655:6.
(The inhabitants of the First Earth) have light from a certain flame... because they do not adore the Lord...
The reason these stones = celestial love, is their red and flaming colour.
That they were of the Celestial Kingdom was given to be seen from the flaming which was the source of their ideas.
A human form seen in a flaming beam...
That flaming beam descended... and now appeared in a flaming verging to lucidity...
The Voluntary is as a flame, and its Intellectual is as the light from it.
The light in the Celestial Kingdom appears flaming, because the Angels there receive light from the Lord as a Sun.
The most intelligent Angels have garments which sparkle as from flame. HH 179.
To think and will, and thence to do, is like a flame which gives heat and light all around.
A flaming appears from those Hells where the love of the world reigns.
Flame corresponds to the evils of the love of self.
By a flame of fire () is meant the affection of falsity.
The Word... from its celestial sense, is as a flame which kindles... From celestial flame it is like a ruby. TCR 216.
Fire and flame are mentioned together, because fire... = good, and flame... truth.
They were so enraged that a flame appeared from their nostrils.

His eyes were as a flame of fire () = the Divine wisdom of the Divine love... By a flame of fire is signified spiritual love, which is charity; and therefore, when predicated of the Lord, it = Divine love. AE 68.
A flaming fire () = the good of love. AE 155:2. AE 419:11.
Lo, a flaming together with light descended from Heaven and consociated them with the Angels.
The flame of a sword turning itself = Divine truth in ultimates. TCR 260:2.

I am tormented in this flame () = the doctrine by the falsities of which he was tormented: for no one in Hell is in flame, but the flame there is the appearance of the love of falsity; and the fire is the appearance of the love of evil.
Flame burst forth and consumed the paper.
In her face there was a resplendence of flaming light...
In our Society... the light derives its quality from the flaming of the Sun, and the flaming of the Sun corresponds to the love of uses.
That the blazing or flame of this love, which is zeal, is a spiritual blazing or flame, which originates from an assault upon the love.
At a distance, love there appears as flame... but this flame does not burn...
As fire breaks forth into flame... For in the will love is as fire, and in the understanding as flame...
This is the source of this spiritual flame.
But the zeal of the love of evil is as an infernal flame.
Flame is nothing but smoke set on fire...

The smoke being ignited burned like a flame, which illuminated the mind below the memory... But with the other... I saw as it were a gentle flame flowing down from Heaven, which illuminated the mind above the memory...
It resembled our flame...
On a flaming before the eyes. See SE 3646.

Afterwards the flame appeared more intense... by which they said was signified natural lumen. It was nothing but a yellowish flame like that from burning wood. I said that if the fieriness from the kindled smoke were absent, the flame would be white, that is, if natural things were absent... then it wold be inwardly white, and thus spiritual, which is signified by a shining-white flame.
He was held suspended in that (infernal) flame, and said that he had never perceived anything more delightful.
There appeared many sparkling flames above the table... This signified their cupidity of truth...
Flame = the truth from good of the inmost Heaven. References. AE 277:3.
The flame of a sword turning itself every way = the terrific driving off and rejecting of all who are in falsities. ( = truth from this good protecting. AE 277:3.)
Fire of flames () = the love of the world.

The interiors of those who are in the love of self and of the world, and thence in hatred and revenge, are meant by their faces being faces of flames (); so do they appear. ( = that they are in the evils of hatred and of anger. AE 721:24.)
The vastation and destruction of the Church by the love of falsity from evil, is signified by the flame of a grievous flame ().
The tongue (of Dives) = the thirst and cupidity of perverting the truths which are in the Word; and the flame, the penalty of this cupidity, which is varied and manifold.

Fire = the good of celestial love, and flame the good of spiritual love; and, in the opposite sense, fire = love which originates from the love of self, and flame, the evil which originates from the love of the world.
The fire of the candlestick, which was flame, = Divine spiritual love.
Fire = evils; and flame, the cupidities thence derived.
Fire = the love of self; and flame, the conceit of our Own intelligence. AE 730:14.
They shall fall by the sword and by flame () = to perish from falsities and derivative evils.

Little flames, like tongues, flowed down from Heaven upon their heads, by which they were inspired with the affection of being wise from reason... Among them was a priest... who said, What has faith to do with reason... then suddenly the little flame fell down from the top of his head upon his shoe, and there shone for a short time. 5M 9:11.
As they were in enlightenment from the little flames upon their heads...
